items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Pete Johnson and Albert Ammons were the two boogie-woogie pianists, and the show also had a Classical pianist...

ctx.x: Eight hours! But that was fun. And anyhow, at the Cafe Society Downtown at this time there was a group called the Reviewers. Judy Holiday was a member of the group, who later became a big star. Pete Johnson and Albert Ammons were the two boogie-woogie pianists, and the show also had a Classical pianist, Sam Reichman Lewis he was called. This was, you know, a lot of fun, although the hours were really ridiculous. Because when you'd get off at 4 o'clock in the morning in New York, you know, you'd go out and eat,…
